newsitem.title: USA: Marsh/McLennan files for secondary offering.
newsitem.headline: Marsh/McLennan files for secondary offering.

text.p: Marsh & McLennan Cos Inc said Wednesday it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the secondary offering of up to 3.44 million common shares.
The shares will be sold by former stockholders and retirees of Johnson & Higgins, the insurance brokerage that it acquired in March.

The offering will be made through J.P. Morgan & Co and Morgan Stanley & Co Inc as joint lead managers. Co-managers of the underwriting are Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Merrill Lynch & Co and PaineWebber Inc.
Marsh & McLennan said it will not receive any proceeds from the offering.
